title: How compound interest grows
question: Money left to grow at a fixed yearly rate earns interest on its interest. How much is there after a number of years?
notes: Interest is added once a year.
Nothing is paid in or taken out along the way.
source: the standard compound interest formula, compounded once a year.

practice.prompt: £2,000 at 3% a year for 5 years. What is the amount?
£1,000 at 7% a year: after how many whole years is there £2,000 or more for the first time?
